+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+import inspect
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+import attrs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "options, forced",
+    [
+        ({"kw_only": True, "force_kw_only": True}, True),
+        ({"kw_only": True, "force_kw_only": False}, False),
+        ({"kw_only": False, "force_kw_only": True}, False),
+        ({"kw_only": False, "force_kw_only": False}, False),
+        ({"kw_only": True}, False),
+        ({}, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_final_keyword_only_policy(options, forced, slots):
+    @attrs.define(kw_only=True, slots=slots)
+    class Base:
+        inherited: int
+
+    @attrs.define(slots=slots)
+    class Added:
+        added: int
+        extra_skipped: int = attrs.field(init=False, default=9)
+
+    def transform(cls, fields):
+        if forced:
+            assert all(a.kw_only is True for a in fields)
+        return (
+            a.evolve(kw_only=False)
+            for a in (*fields, *attrs.fields(Added))
+        )
+
+    @attrs.define(slots=slots, field_transformer=transform, **options)
+    class Child(Base):
+        own: int = attrs.field(kw_only=True)
+        skipped: int = attrs.field(init=False, default=7)
+
+    assert [a.name for a in attrs.fields(Child)] == [
+        "inherited", "own", "skipped", "added", "extra_skipped"
+    ]
+    assert all(a.kw_only is forced for a in attrs.fields(Child))
+    assert attrs.fields(Base).inherited.kw_only is True
+    params = inspect.signature(Child).parameters
+    assert list(params) == ["inherited", "own", "added"]
+    kind = (
+        inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY
+        if forced else inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD
+    )
+    assert all(p.kind is kind for p in params.values())
+    if sys.version_info >= (3, 10):
+        assert Child.__match_args__ == (
+            () if forced else ("inherited", "own", "added")
+        )
+    child = Child(inherited=1, own=2, added=3)
+    assert attrs.astuple(child) == (1, 2, 7, 3, 9)
+    if forced:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+            Child(1, 2, 3)
+    else:
+        assert Child(1, 2, 3) == child
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kw_only, force_kw_only", [
+    (True, True), (True, False), (False, True), (False, False)
+])
+def test_transformed_default_before_mandatory(kw_only, force_kw_only, slots):
+    @attrs.define(slots=slots)
+    class Base:
+        first: int = 10
+
+    def transform(cls, fields):
+        return [a.evolve(kw_only=False) for a in fields]
+
+    def build():
+        @attrs.define(
+            kw_only=kw_only,
+            force_kw_only=force_kw_only,
+            slots=slots,
+            field_transformer=transform,
+        )
+        class Child(Base):
+            required: int
+
+        return Child
+
+    if not (kw_only and force_kw_only):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="No mandatory attributes allowed"):
+            build()
+        return
+
+    child_cls = build()
+    assert all(a.kw_only is True for a in attrs.fields(child_cls))
+    params = inspect.signature(child_cls).parameters
+    assert list(params) == ["first", "required"]
+    assert all(p.kind is inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY for p in params.values())
+    assert params["first"].default == 10
+    assert params["required"].default is inspect.Parameter.empty
+    assert attrs.astuple(child_cls(required=4)) == (10, 4)
+    if sys.version_info >= (3, 10):
+        assert child_cls.__match_args__ == ()
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        child_cls(10, 4)

spec.question:
Strengthen attrs' keyword-only contract when both kw_only=True and force_kw_only=True are selected. Every final field returned by field_transformer must be keyword-only, including inherited fields that the transformer changes to kw_only=False and positional fields that it adds. This must also allow a transformed default-valued field to precede a mandatory field, since neither will be positional in the generated initializer.

Keep define's force_kw_only default False. Under the YES policy (kw_only=True, force_kw_only=False) and the NO policy (kw_only=False), continue honoring the transformer's keyword-only choices and rejecting invalid positional default-before-mandatory ordering. Preserve the policy metadata currently presented to the transformer, and do not alter the base class's fields when decorating a subclass. Generated initializer signatures and generated __match_args__ must reflect the final policy; init=False fields must remain excluded from both initializer parameters and positional matching.

Return a unified diff against the non-test repository files. Leave existing tests unchanged.
